Spec asked both refund AND privacy pages to reflect the new rules; consider adding a brief cross-reference clause. Non-blocking.

rca_of_bug_fixed.bug: Customer Account page always displayed 'Return window closed (+ days since delivery)' even for freshly delivered orders — Request Return button never appeared, breaking the entire Phase A customer return flow.
rca_of_bug_fixed.root_cause: Order Pydantic model in /app/backend/server.py did not declare delivered_at field. The backend admin_update_order() correctly persisted delivered_at into MongoDB when status='delivered', but GET /api/me/orders (response_model=List[Order]) with ConfigDict(extra='ignore') silently stripped delivered_at from the response payload. Frontend AccountPage.jsx then computed deliveredAt=null -> daysSince=null -> withinWindow=false -> always rendered 'Return window closed' branch.
rca_of_bug_fixed.fix: Added `delivered_at: Optional[str] = None` to Order model (server.py line ~81). Verified via curl that /me/orders now returns delivered_at ISO string.
rca_of_bug_fixed.reproduction: 1) Create COD order 2) Admin PATCH /admin/orders/{n} {status:'delivered'} 3) GET /me/orders — delivered_at was missing before fix, present after.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update /policies/privacy content to briefly restate the strict 3-day window & original-packaging clauses (spec asked for both refund + privacy pages to reflect these rules).
No other action items — Phase A Returns feature is functionally complete and verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Order model was missing delivered_at declaration despite backend writing it — same class of bug could recur for other status timestamps (e.g. shipped_at, packed_at). Consider a StatusTimestamps sub-model or generic dict.

AccountPage return-window logic uses Math.floor days: an order delivered <24h ago shows '3 days left' (0 elapsed). Frontend and backend both use days-floored math, so they stay consistent, but a stricter 72h check (hours) would match the legal policy verbatim ('72 hours from the timestamp').
ReturnRequest response leaks user_email; acceptable for own /me/returns but confirm this endpoint enforces user filter (it does via find({user_email: user.email})).
